title: Al-Qudwah al-Hasanah in the Prophetic Tarbiyah
reference_info: المنهاج التربوي النبوي — د. عدنان الخليفي

text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of al-qudwah al-hasanah (good role modeling) in tarbiyah, drawing upon the seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It clarifies that the Prophet ﷺ was a practical example of the Qur'an in his akhlaq and conduct. It also highlights that tarbiyah of the self upon 'ibadah (worship) and obedience positively impacts all aspects of life.

review_defects.why: The honorific 'الكريم' (the Noble) is omitted in the English rendering, dropping the reverential descriptor for the Qur'an.
